title: Why a retailer reduces contacts
caption: Five producers each selling to 20 customers need 100 transactions. Through one retailer they need 5 + 20 = 25. The retailer cuts contacts and costs, though it takes a margin.
alt: Two columns: 100 transactions when five producers sell direct to 20 customers, and 25 through one retailer.
description: Through one retailer: 5 to the retailer and 20 to customers, 25 in all.
